The two linear equations intersect at exactly one point:
\[
3x+2 \;=\; 2x+3 \;\Longrightarrow\; x=1,\qquad 
y=3(1)+2=5 .
\]
So the intersection point is  
**\( (\,1 ,\, 5\, ) \)**.
